name: Margin
welcome_title: Write with your sources beside you
welcome_text: Margin reads your reports, papers and interview notes. Search them, follow topics, concepts and themes across them, see which claims of your own draft they support or contradict, and check a hypothesis against them, always with the exact quotes so you can judge for yourself.
description: Write with your sources beside you: check the claims of your draft and your hypotheses against your documents, with verified quotes.
